buildCommand: npm run build -w @Ken/shared && npm run build -w @Ken/client
_comment_rewrites: Vercel matches the filesystem before it applies a rewrite, so files in client/public are already served on their own. The SEO assets are still named here explicitly: when robots.txt did not exist, this rewrite answered /robots.txt with index.html at 200 - Content-Type text/html, filename index.html - and crawlers read markup where directives belong. A 404 would have been recoverable; a 200 of the wrong type was not, because nothing reported an error. Naming them means a future build that drops one fails loudly instead of silently serving HTML again.
